scope: Actual separate disposable project GUI observation after reviewed handoff and fresh native copy controls. No live source application, plugin, undo or human/electrical approval.
prerequisites: Audited source checkpoint and read-back for handoff integration and native controller
Actual owned-fixture review-copy result plus unchanged positive and required-via-removal native negative
Central saved-result checking and complete original/accepted-run project inventories before UI access
resource_scope: Manual active-session observation, not a routing benchmark; GUI CPU and hidden external process work are not comparative timing data. Native prerequisite has its own full bounded accounting. Stop and retain incomplete evidence at the observation limit.
sequence: Create each new complete review project with the qualified CLI; require exact copied candidate/source/rule bindings before opening
Use actual UI tools to open only the exact disposable board; inspect displayed version and geometry/connectivity counters
Run native GUI Design Rules Checker with zone refill and errors/warnings/exclusions visible; do not change severities/libraries to suppress findings
Export actual raw report through GUI to the matching disposable evidence location; record format and hash, observed options and counts
Compare categories/ignored checks/configuration against the source-bound CLI report without asserting equality when different
Close and discard only the owned disposable project; record board/project/history/PRL changes and verify all original/accepted-run bytes unchanged
Confirm no task-owned PCB Editor window/process remains; do not close or kill unrelated windows/processes
failure_handling: Missing permissions, ambiguous board/window identity, unsupported export or missing report is incomplete GUI qualification. Preserve the current source/run and all failed observations; no mocked GUI substitution.
claims_excluded: Fresh GUI DRC cannot retroactively authenticate mutable prior receipts
No full native semantic migration or original-format admission
No selected-net routing, live apply/undo, unsaved-source-editor detection, manufacturing or electrical validation
No completion-rate, performance or independent-family comparison
